title: Differentially heated square cavity
description: Air (Pr=0.71) in a unit square, hot left wall, cold right wall, adiabatic top and bottom, Boussinesq buoyancy. Benchmark quantities: average and maximum hot-wall Nusselt number and maximum mid-plane velocities (non-dimensional).

reference.citation: G. de Vahl Davis, Natural convection of air in a square cavity: a bench mark numerical solution, Int. J. Numer. Methods Fluids 3 (1983) 249-264. Velocities are scaled by alpha/L. Values cross-checked against secondary tables that quote the benchmark (see docs/reference-data.md).
